selection_rule: If segment0 is short, select the first k with sum(norm(F[i+1]-F[i]), i=0..k-1) >= 0.02m. Heading0 = atan2(Fk-F0). Stop if no k or zero chord. Other headings retain original outgoing/last-incoming tangents.
tangent_factor_variant: During optimization replace only node0 heading-tangent residual with X0->Xk using the frozen k; do not reselect k.
minimum_adjacent_segment_penalty: Unchanged on all 7 original adjacent segments, including short segment0.
other_factor_scales_safety_targets_and_s: Unchanged minimal_se2_graph_protocol.json; initial increments are zero from FRESH poses with the variant-derived heading0.
input_firewall: Only FRESH52 sample0, observation pose, actual B52, active obstacle/corridor geometry, original controller and frozen protocol enter solve. Actual RAW segment and prior results are validation/reference after solve only. No FRESH53 or later collision inputs.
b_local_input: unchanged observation-anchored world index2 in B52 frame
rigid_graph_input: explicitly corrected world index2 in B52 frame
stop: literal (0,0), no waypoint or future trajectory
outputs: small JSON/CSV, one XY comparison figure, concise report
